entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A rebel faction in Ghirapur on Kaladesh led by Pia Nalaar, who opposed the corrupt Consulate.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Government of Ghirapur accused of corruption by the Renegades.

entities.name: Leaking Spire
entities.description: Symbol of the Renegades, an upside-down Aether Collection Tower.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: Owner of a hidden cache of artifacts the Renegades turned into weapons.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group distracted by a diversion attack while the Consulate retook the Aether Hub.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Defeated, after which the Consulate yielded.

events.summary: The Renegades attack the Aether Hub and its personnel yield.
events.quote: the renegades attacked the Aether Hub

events.summary: The Consulate retakes the Aether Hub while the Gatewatch is distracted by a diversion attack by Baral and Dovin Baan.
events.quote: the Consulate took control of the Aether Hub again

events.summary: After Tezzeret's final defeat, the Consulate yields and Renegades are integrated into it.
events.quote: After the final defeat of Tezzeret , the Consulate yielded.

relations.quote: They were led by Pia Nalaar .
The Renegades believed that the Consulate was corrupt
